test check-access-filters
# Test Check Access construction of select/exclude filters for the ZCLONE_TEST files.
# NOTE: Include Other tests may result in listing diffs due to zclone processing order change. False fail.
#
# Tests are done in two phases:
#  - EXCLUDE OTHER tests check that ZCLONE_TEST files are only found in the explicitly included directories
#  - INCLUDE OTHER tesss check that ZCLONE_TEST files are found in all directories not explicitly excluded
#
# Each phase checks that:
#  - missing ZCLONE_TEST files in don't care directories don't cause failures
#  - missing ZCLONE_TEST files in care directories do cause failures

test EXCLUDE - OTHER TESTS
copy-file {datadir/}exclude-other-filtersfile.txt {workdir/}

test resync to get the filters file md5 built.
bisync resync filters-file={workdir/}exclude-other-filtersfile.txt

test EXCLUDE - test filters for check access
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}exclude-other-filtersfile.txt
copy-listings exclude-initial

test EXCLUDE - delete ZCLONE_TEST files in excluded directories
delete-file {path2/}subdir/subdirA/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdir-not/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path2/}subdir-not/subdir-not2/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdirX/ZCLONE_TEST

test EXCLUDE - test should PASS
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}exclude-other-filtersfile.txt
copy-listings exclude-pass-run

test EXCLUDE - delete ZCLONE_TEST files in included directories
delete-file {path2/}ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdir/ZCLONE_TEST

test EXCLUDE - test should ABORT
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}exclude-other-filtersfile.txt
move-listings exclude-error-run

test INCLUDE - OTHER TESTS
test reset to the initial state
copy-dir {testdir/}initial {path1/}
sync-dir {path1/} {path2/}
copy-file {datadir/}include-other-filtersfile.txt {workdir/}
bisync resync filters-file={workdir/}include-other-filtersfile.txt

test INCLUDE - test include/exclude filters for check access
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}include-other-filtersfile.txt
copy-listings include-initial

test INCLUDE - delete ZCLONE_TEST files in excluded directories
delete-file {path2/}subdir/subdirA/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdir-not/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path2/}subdir-not/subdir-not2/ZCLONE_TEST

test INCLUDE - test should PASS
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}include-other-filtersfile.txt
copy-listings include-pass-run

test INCLUDE - delete ZCLONE_TEST files in included directories
delete-file {path2/}ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdir/ZCLONE_TEST
delete-file {path1/}subdirX/subdirX1/ZCLONE_TEST

test INCLUDE - test should ABORT
bisync check-access filters-file={workdir/}include-other-filtersfile.txt
move-listings include-error-run
